scope: Factorized epistemic bookkeeping specialized over BridgeCore structural transport. The contract records evidence, retrieval, inference, verification, execution, conflict, and scope without defining a universal epistemic ladder or physical truth oracle.

fields.evidence_refs: declared evidence/source identifiers supporting the represented state
fields.retrieved_refs: retrieval events or source references; retrieval is not verification
fields.inference_refs: declared inference/premise references; inference is not verification
fields.execution_receipts: execution receipts; execution is not verification
fields.scope: nonempty contexts/regimes for which the epistemic bookkeeping is licensed

validity.activity_requires_evidence: any nonempty retrieved_refs, inference_refs, verification_receipts, execution_receipts, or conflict_refs requires nonempty evidence_refs
validity.unknown_definition: all evidence and authority fields are empty

transport_contract.authority_rule: authority-neutral structural transport copies every authority field exactly
transport_contract.scope_rule: target scope equals source scope intersect BridgeCore scope and must be nonempty
transport_contract.promotion_rule: structural transport cannot add verification, execution, inference, retrieval, conflict, or evidence records

execution_limits.policy: Finite enumeration validates the declared factorized bookkeeping model only; it is not a general theory of knowledge or truth.

explicit_deferrals: global confidence ordering or epistemic lattice
